applyTo: "**/*.html,**/*.css,**/*.scss,**/*.tsx,**/*.jsx,**/*.vue,**/*.svelte"

# Shared design system
Maintain one coherent source for shared design values using the project's CSS, theme, or token conventions. Reuse semantic roles where that improves consistency.

Add token layers only as useful. No mandatory palette length, prefix, library, color space, font, radius, or number of layers applies. Preserve existing theme APIs.

Use consistent typography, spacing, controls, and component anatomy for equivalent content. Allow intentional variation when workflows differ.

Keep DESIGN.md concise: rationale, key conventions, and where values live. Refer to code for exhaustive values instead of maintaining a second token inventory.
